cause_quote: The diff passed `bundleURLs: Bundle.allBundles.map(\.bundleURL) + [Bundle.main.bundleURL]` to the resolver, forcing it to read every bundle URL even when an earlier bundle already identified the test runner.
summary: The fix caches macOS test-runner detection and checks process metadata before inspecting loaded bundles.
reasoning: I checked that Quick Chat already called the getter during permission setup before #113337, when the getter could return on the first loaded XCTest bundle without reading subsequent URLs. The change made every URL read eager, which can terminate the native test process when a transient bundle loses its URL. The fix documents a missing-URL negative control against the eager getter, but the evidence does not establish the bundle order in the failing run.
